# flac-lite subframe-BODY golden vectors -- GENERATED
# DO NOT EDIT BY HAND.  Regenerate with:  scripts/gen_frame_vectors.sh
# Generator + independent walk: scripts/frame_vectors.py (emit_bodies)
# Source streams: scripts/frame_vectors.py synth (integer-exact, no RNG)
# Encoder: flac 1.5.0
#
# Ground truth for step 3e's `decode_subframe`, in two independent
# layers: `frame_hex` is raw libFLAC bytes; the field values come from
# the independent Bits walk (a naive bit-loop reader -- a second
# mechanism from crates/flac-lite's accumulator); `pcm_samples` come
# from the reference DECODER (flac -d), so reconstruction is witnessed
# by a second decoder, not by the harness re-deriving the same sums.
# Every stream additionally passed the footer-gap, warm-up == own PCM,
# and body == PCM invariants at generation time (walk_stream_bodies),
# and the per-stream kind census is fail-closed: a libFLAC upgrade that
# changes any expected kind refuses to write this file.
#
# exit_bits is relative to the START of frame_hex (the frame's first
# byte), and is where the reader must land after the subframe body --
# before the frame footer (pad-to-byte + CRC-16), which is 3f's.
